results.title: American Football (Live in Los Angeles)
results.overview: American Football (Live in Los Angeles) is an intimate concert film celebrating the 25th anniversary of the band’s groundbreaking debut album. Featuring live performances and candid interviews with the band, Ethel Cain, Yvette Young, and M.A.G.S., the film highlights the band’s enduring legacy and their pivotal role in defining the genre.

results.title: Henry Fonda for President
results.overview: A personal essay about the United States viewed through the life and work of the late American film and stage actor Henry Fonda.

results.title: DESERTEUR
results.overview: After escaping a concentration camp in Nazi-occupied France, a refugee encounters a Nazi deserter standing on a landmine rigged to explode.

results.title: Fury
results.overview: Alex, a young actress, is sexually assaulted at a New Year’s Eve party at a friend’s house. That night, she never manages to see the face of her aggressor, a fact that will end up eating away at her. Throughout the following year, she will have to face feelings of guilt, disgust and shame.  While Alex tries to channel all her pain through theatre, where she takes on the role of the famously vengeful Medea, her brother, Adrian, must face the guilt he feels at not having been able to protect his sister and his impulse to let himself be carried away by his own decisions.  What were once the typical conflicts you might expect between any siblings, give way to much more extreme and complex emotions.

results.title: Torment of the Witch
results.overview: A fashion model, shocked by her best friend's murder, finds a clue that spirals her into the ghostly world of an occult killer and reveals a secret too dangerous to imagine.

results.title: Junket
results.overview: Chaos ensues as a gay actor and his female costar fake being a couple as they try to save the press junket for their new television show.

results.title: Trajectoire
results.overview: Montreal, June 2025: Clémence, a young emerging musical artist, discovers the existence of her twin brother Simon, separated from her at birth. Eager to help her brother financially, Clémence naively falls for an online scam. The film explores the themes of family resilience and fraternal solidarity, while following the journey of Clémence, who is desperately trying to break in the music industry.

results.title: Disco Beats
results.overview: Set in Detroit 1979, an elderly man tries to convince a jaded disco dance instructor to teach him how to dance so he can surprise his wife on their 60th wedding anniversary...in one week.

results.title: Alfie Brown: The Last Cancelled Comedian
results.original_title: Alfie Brown: The Last Cancelled Comedian
results.overview: Award winning and latterly disgraced comedian Alfie Brown is back. This is his first full special since the resurfacing of an old routine put his career in ruins. In this show he's tries to navigate the story of his own cancellation without turning into one of those right wing free speech comedians. Comment below if you think he managed it.

results.title: Plum Blossom in March
results.overview: University lecturer Xiao Renyuan returns to his hometown to attend a funeral and, along the way, encounters civil servant Leng Chunhua, who is heading to Shierpan Village for targeted poverty alleviation work. Inspired by the efforts of the poverty alleviation team, the traditionally minded Zhang Gui undergoes a change in mindset: adjusting agricultural structures, embracing technological innovation, and joining forces with impoverished households to fight the battle against poverty. Meanwhile, with Chunhua's help, the emotional rift between father and son is gradually healed.

results.title: Tiger
results.overview: Tigre is the animated story of a friend's grandfather, a refugee from Laos, living in Thailand. A narrative full of uncertainty and curiosity, where nothing is everything and everything is nothing, and where appearances deceive.

results.title: American Solitaire
results.overview: A U.S. soldier struggles to make sense of civilian life when he is confronted with the complexities of gun violence in America

results.overview: Familiar Stranger is an intimate, dialogue-light drama about identity, belonging, and the unexpected ways two people can find connection across discomfort and time.

results.title: Liar, Liar, Love is on Fire
results.overview: Influencer couple Xu Xiaoli and her "hired boyfriend" Hao Zha face a fan crisis and pressure from their boss. In response, Xu Xiaoli plans a fake wedding, but when Hao Zha unexpectedly disappears, she embarks on a wild chase to find him. Will their relationship survive the chaos?
